difficulty.rationale: Students must recognize that angular displacement is the area under the omega-t graph and sum a triangle, a rectangle and a trapezoid with simple integer values (12+24+12=48 rad). Distractors map to common misconceptions (max speed times time, constant-speed segment only, slope). The given moment of inertia is an unused detail, but it adds little reading load. This is a single-concept item on rotational kinematics with minimal computation, so it fits basic learning rather than a full-mock exam-prep item.
